topics.name: Search Query Identity
topics.purpose: Define each material search/discovery request as explicit query evidence with exact source scope, criteria, ranking profile and requester context.

semantics.identity_rule: Each machine-significant search execution/request has explicit identity.
semantics.requester_rule: Requester/governance context is explicit where protected sources are involved.
semantics.authority_rule: Search result visibility follows source authorization/governance.

invariants.rule: Machine-significant identity, type, relation, state and meaning are explicit and never inferred solely from display text, path, layout, file order, timestamp or implementation accident.
Resolved, projected, indexed, cached, formatted or derived representations never become source-of-truth or authority merely because they are convenient or available.
